When the affix णि (causal follows, गामि is the substitute of इण् when the sense is not that of 'informing' but that of 'going'.

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् is the causative णि , when that causative takes the affix सन् (Desiderative) and चन् (Aorist).

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel, in the causative of श्वि , when followed by the Desiderative सन् and the Aorist चङ् affix.

Terms:

A short is substituted for the vowel, standing in a penultimate position, the Causative अङ्ग (stem), when the affix चङ् (sign of the Reduplicate Aorist of the Causatives) follows.

Terms: Aorist shortening
